import random, json, sys
from harness import *
random.seed(99)
L=[{"kind":"local","subject":s} for s in ("session-k","solo","foreign","ghost")]
P=[{"kind":"peer","name":n} for n in ("edge","other","ghost")]
U=[{"kind":"untrusted"},{"kind":"weird"},{}]
ING=L+P+U
GWS=["edge","inside","narrow","mixed","ghost"]
base_texts=[req(), req(privacy="id"), req(frm=["<sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid>"],tag=None),
            req(extra=["P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test>"]),
            req(extra=["P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test>, <tel:+12025550121>",
                       "Remote-Party-ID: <sip:ember@studio.test>",
                       "P-Preferred-Identity: <tel:+12025550121>"]),
            req(method="INVITE", cseq="7 INVITE", body="")]
policy = gw.Policy(BASE["directory"], BASE["accounts"], BASE["gateways"])
internal=0; acc=0; rej={}; wirefail=0
for n in range(40000):
    jobs=[]
    results=[]
    k=random.randint(1,4)
    for i in range(k):
        if i>0 and random.random()<0.5:
            job={"gateway":random.choice(GWS),"ingress":random.choice(ING),"trusted_out":random.random()<0.5,
                 "source":random.randrange(i)}
        else:
            job={"gateway":random.choice(GWS),"ingress":random.choice(ING),"trusted_out":random.random()<0.5,
                 "raw":random.choice(base_texts)}
        jobs.append(job)
    batch=json.loads(json.dumps(BASE)); batch["jobs"]=jobs
    out=gw.process(batch)["results"]
    assert len(out)==len(jobs)
    for r in out:
        if r["status"]=="accept":
            acc+=1
            assert set(r)=={"status","identity","basis","private","wire"}, set(r)
            assert r["identity"] in BASE["directory"], r
            assert r["basis"] in ("local","peer")
            assert isinstance(r["private"], bool)
            try:
                p2=gw.parse_request(r["wire"])
            except Exception as e:
                wirefail+=1
                if wirefail<4: print("WIREFAIL", type(e).__name__, e, repr(r["wire"])[:300])
        else:
            assert set(r)=={"status","reason"}, set(r)
            assert r["reason"] in ("upstream","syntax","unauthenticated","identity"), r
            rej[r["reason"]]=rej.get(r["reason"],0)+1
    # direct internals for exception detection
    results=[]
    for job in jobs:
        try:
            results.append(gw.run_job(job, policy, results))
        except gw.Reject as e:
            results.append({"status":"reject","reason":e.reason})
        except Exception as e:
            internal+=1
            if internal<6: print("INTERNAL", type(e).__name__, e, json.dumps(job)[:300])
            results.append({"status":"reject","reason":"syntax"})
print("accepts",acc,"rejects",rej,"internal",internal,"wirefail",wirefail)
PYEOF
